title: CSR Partnerships · Janswabhiman Welfare Society
subtitle: Fulfil your CSR mandate with work you can see, verify, and stand behind.
intro: Janswabhiman Welfare Society runs education, tribal welfare, women empowerment, animal welfare, refugee rehabilitation, and disaster relief programs across 8 states. Partner with us to direct your CSR budget toward measurable, on-ground impact — with full documentation for your compliance team.

highlights.title: Compliant by design
highlights.desc: Fully registered with 80G and 12A status and CSR-1 filing in place, so your contribution is straightforward to document and report.

highlights.title: On-ground, not outsourced
highlights.desc: Our own teams run centers, gaushalas, and relief camps directly across 8 states — your funds reach the program, not subcontractors.

highlights.title: Transparent reporting
highlights.desc: Every partnership comes with photo documentation, utilization reports, and site visit access for internal sign-off and disclosure.

highlights.title: Schedule VII Aligned
highlights.desc: From education to disaster relief, our programs map directly to Schedule VII categories.

scheduleVII.activity: Free learning centers for children from underserved and slum communities, including refugee children
Kanyadaan / Samuhik Vivah for poor/tribal daughters, skill training, vocational self-employment
scheduleVII.category: Item (iii): Promoting gender equality, empowering women

scheduleVII.activity: Waterproof huts, shelters, livelihood assistance, and schooling for refugee families
Street animal rescue, veterinary medical treatment, feeding drives
Sanctuary care and sustainable fodder for 100+ rescued abandoned and injured cows
Self-employment, cultural preservation, food distribution, sports tournaments in SC/ST belts
Emergency relief kits, food, shelter during floods, droughts, and Covid waves
scheduleVII.category: Item (xii): Disaster management, including relief and rehabilitation
